name: aim-gap-crouch
description: ANSWER A to the aim gap (?crouch=1): identical to aim-gap-8way.json — same route, same stop, same 2.5s of held fire on the same target — plus DOWN held while firing, which drops the firing line from 1.05 to 0.45 and the profile from 1.7 to 1.0. Expected: the same ~20 shots now kill the houndframe. The stance is planted, so the trade is explicit: the low line costs all horizontal speed while it is held.
